purpose: Ground truth of the Chaos Clash flow as it exists at the 9B.2 head, so the six-state refactor is laid over facts. Read-only survey; nothing here proposes a change. Claims marked verified were re-read directly after the survey.

serverPhases.note: sequence 2 (live) hires from ROLL_3_REVEALED; COACH_SELECTION is legacy sequence 1 (runState.js:536-545)

clientDerivation.note: no explicit client state enum; drafting/selecting/ready are derived from the run object; one cta object and a data-focus attribute (:278-281) drive presentation

renderBranchesToday.note: post-game branch vs everything else; all six target states currently share one JSX tree

resultDock.finding: mounted unconditionally inside the rail, never unmounted — this is why the previous Clash persists while a new one is built
resultDock.internalStates: ResultDock.jsx:329 complete · :332 simulating · :358 prior result · :361 empty
resultDock.prevPhaseRef: ResultDock.jsx:128-132 auto-opens the Story only on simulating→complete; unmounting the dock between states kills it

liveIntel.finding: always mounted, never collapsible as a whole; two inner toggles only (rulesOpen :106, eraOpen :119)

coachChaos.finding: always rendered from the empty board onward; three placeholders when offers are empty; only visually subdued via data-active; actionable hire begins at selecting, i.e. after Roll 3 lands, which is when the five is complete

eraReveal.client: no dedicated state; surfaces in LiveIntel.jsx:66-88, UtilityBar.jsx:48-57, the CTA sub-copy ChaosStage.jsx:212, and an sr-only region :296-298
eraReveal.analytics: chaos_era_revealed at ChaosStage.jsx:168 compares new vs old revealed — a dedicated state must not double-fire

clashReadyRead.finding: Chaos has NO matchup preview; its pre-sim read is Live Intel. The 'MATCHUP PREVIEW' read and e2e/phase7b-preview.spec.js P1 belong to Dream Matchup (MatchupPreview.jsx, PlayPanels.jsx, api/_lib/pregameRead.js), not to this flow.

postgameHooks.savePanel: src/components/accounts/SaveThisClash.jsx:43 (signed-in) / :67 (guest), rendered inside renderReport when live && resultId (App.jsx:1791-1800), reached via onViewFullReport → setFullReport (App.jsx:1941-1946) → overlay :2033-2046
postgameHooks.runItBack: ResultDock.jsx:305 → App.jsx:1947 doRematch('chaos') (:1156-1166); saved-roster path runItBackFromSaved (:1176-1186) via goldOverride on runSingle (:988-1000)

e2e: e2e/phase8c-time-arena.spec.js (24 tests: .ec-ta columns, CTA labels, dock, mobile order)

uiGates.uiQa.mjs:195-196: requires the literals ROLL 1 / LOCK & ROLL 2 / FINAL ROLL / HIRE THIS STAFF / RUN SIM inside ChaosStage.jsx specifically
uiGates.time-arena-qa.mjs:66-83: the nine-screenshot states walk waits on .ec-intel-era-id, then .ec-coach-card nth(2) BEFORE the hire step, then RUN SIM, then FINAL SCORE

risks: resumed ref (ChaosStage.jsx:101,127-140) fires once per mount; separately mounted state components would re-run or skip the resume pass
runKey effect (ChaosStage.jsx:119-124) re-seeds holds/coachHolds/picked on chaosRunId:roll:phase; new branches must not remount away a pending decision mid-roll
ResultDock prevPhase ref and its 30s agoLabel interval depend on staying mounted; a Result hero that unmounts the drafting dock loses the LAST CLASH state
localStorage ec_chaos_run / ec_chaos_run_at written ChaosStage.jsx:36-40, removed App.jsx:1222,1248, read by the lobby Continue card (runStorage.js:4-5)
analytics call sites: chaos_roll_completed :156,:167 · chaos_era_revealed :168 · chaos_coach_selected :174 · result_tab_opened ResultDock.jsx:202 · new_clash_started App.jsx:1238
hiding Coach Chaos until the five is complete breaks time-arena-qa.mjs:69 unless the walk is updated; moving CTA literals out of ChaosStage.jsx breaks uiQa.mjs:195
onReady fires only on hire (ChaosStage.jsx:174); runChaosClash reads chaosRun || chaosReady (App.jsx:1205-1206) because a reloaded READY run never fires it
designConsequences: Result Dock must be removed from the board while a new Clash is being built without losing the simulating→complete transition or the LAST CLASH affordance elsewhere
Era Reveal needs a dedicated client state gated on the ROLL_2_REVEALED transition, firing chaos_era_revealed exactly once
Coach Chaos must not mount until the five is complete (selecting), and the states walk must be updated to match
Live Intel becomes progressive disclosure; Draft Pressure keeps exactly one visible instance
Clash Ready has one primary action, RUN CLASH; gates that pin RUN SIM / HIRE THIS STAFF literals will need deliberate, recorded updates rather than silent edits
